_comment: TOOLS BY OTHER CREATORS that we point at. Curated in the CMS; git is the
audit trail.
THESE ARE NOT PACKAGES, and they must never appear in manifest.json's
`packages` array. A row there is assumed by everything downstream to be
ours: Compare() versions it, the updater fetches it, InstallerExt installs
it, `requires` is derived for it, and the removed-guard would demand you
declare it retired the day the author's link dies.
WE LINK, WE DO NOT HOST. `url` opens the author's own page in a browser.
Nothing is fetched, nothing is hashed, nothing enters the store. We cannot
pin bytes we do not control -- the file behind someone else's URL can
change whenever they like -- and putting one in the store would enrol it
in the update rail, which is exactly what this list promises not to do.
This file publishes on its own, not with a release: edit, run
`python packaging/upload.py --recommendations`, and it reaches every
install within minutes. That independence is the safety valve -- pulling a
recommendation must never wait for a release.
Per row: name, author, author_url, url (all required except author_url),
description, and an optional free-form category for grouping. Version,
sha256 and requires are REFUSED by the validator, so this list cannot
drift into looking like a package list.
intro: Tools by other creators in the TouchDesigner community that I use and recommend. Their authors make them, maintain them and support them. Show them some love!

tools.name: TauCeti
tools.author: PlusPlusOneGmbH
tools.description: Preset management and parameter tweening: store, recall and fade between parameter states, with a dashboard, a cue list and a CHOP mapper.

tools.name: QR Code COMP
tools.author: Wieland Hilker
tools.description: Generates QR codes as a TOP from any text or URL.

tools.name: EssentiaTD
tools.author: Darien Brito
tools.description: Real-time and offline audio analysis as native CHOPs, powered by Essentia: spectrum, mel bands, MFCCs, pitch, key, onsets and BPM, and EBU R128 loudness. Windows and macOS.

tools.name: Embody
tools.author: Dylan Roscover
tools.description: Externalizes your network to files you can diff and version, and runs an MCP server so AI assistants can build and debug in your live TouchDesigner session.

tools.name: TDFam
tools.author: dotsimulate and Function Store
tools.description: Custom operator families for TouchDesigner: your own tab in the OP Create dialog, manifests, placement, stubs and in-place updates, in one component.

tools.name: Swaggy Bokeh
tools.author: OVVO Studio
tools.description: Physically based depth of field in GLSL, with bokeh, autofocus and a focus overlay. Drop in your scene camera, or composite a render with a depth pass.

tools.name: MediaPipe TouchDesigner
tools.author: Torin Blankensmith and Dom Scott
tools.description: GPU-accelerated MediaPipe in TouchDesigner, on Mac and PC with no installation: face, hand, pose, object and gesture tracking, segmentation and classification.
